intro: Wednesday brings a security deadline for dormant repositories, simpler C++ setup and new animation benchmarks. Storm preparations lead BC news, while garden lights, waterfront festivities and an education gathering offer dates to plan ahead.

stories.title: Dormant repositories face a Dependabot pause
stories.summary: Starting December 8, GitHub will disable Dependabot alerts on most repositories inactive for a year, archiving existing findings. A push or manual reactivation restores alerts; enforced security configurations and qualifying enterprise policies can preserve continuous coverage.

stories.title: Copilot’s C++ server automates MSBuild setup
stories.summary: Microsoft’s C++ language server for Copilot CLI now bundles and automatically invokes its MSBuild compilation-database extractor. This removes a separate setup step before precise code navigation; other build systems still require supplied compilation commands or a generation skill.

stories.title: Gemini 4 Carbon enters Copilot
stories.summary: GitHub is gradually rolling out Gemini 4 Carbon across supported Copilot clients for Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise users. Billing follows provider list pricing under usage-based billing; organizational access also depends on administrator model policies.

stories.title: Figma separates animation skill from drawing
stories.summary: Figma researchers introduced MotionGraphicsBench, with 100 tasks asking models to animate supplied SVG designs against programmatic checks. Of 32 models evaluated, only four exceeded 50% first-attempt success at their highest available reasoning settings.

stories.title: Province warns of sudden storm closures
stories.summary: BC’s transportation ministry warns of heavy rain, wind and possible flooding on South Coast highways through the rest of the week. Highway 99, Highway 1 and the Malahat face pooling water, debris and short-notice closures; check DriveBC before travelling.

stories.title: DNA links four bears to Bella Coola deaths
stories.summary: Conservation officers confirmed Tuesday that DNA linked a female grizzly and three yearling cubs to the deaths of Jenny Balcarras and Selah Reed. All four bears were killed; investigators say the attack likely involved rare predatory behaviour.

stories.title: Bank minutes explain concern over spreading costs
stories.summary: Newly released October deliberations show Bank of Canada officials examining how persistent energy costs could spread through production and distribution. Businesses expected to pass on more increases over the next year, supporting the decision to raise the policy rate.

events.date: 2026-11-27 · VanDusen Botanical Garden, 5251 Oak Street, Vancouver
events.title: Festival of Lights opens its garden paths
events.description: VanDusen’s seasonal display spreads more than a million lights across 15 acres, with Dancing Lights, themed areas and food vendors. Book a timed entry for the November 27–January 3 run; December 1 offers a sensory-friendly evening.

events.date: 2026-11-16 · Jack Poole Plaza, 1055 Canada Place, Vancouver
events.title: Christmas Market presale ends Sunday
events.description: The waterfront market opens Monday and runs through December 24, with seasonal food, shopping and evening entertainment. Presale pricing ends November 15; single-entry tickets require a 30-minute arrival window, while children six and under enter free.

meetups.description: BC + AI and Ethọ́s Lab invite participants to share one practice worth keeping, one to abandon and one unresolved question. Bring an experiment for small-group discussion about tools, assessment, consent and student agency; registration is open.

dining.title: Notch8 sets a Thanksgiving table
dining.description: The three-course American Thanksgiving menu pairs spiced squash bisque with Fraser Valley turkey ballotine, pomme aligot and pumpkin pavlova. Adults pay $80 before tax and gratuity; reserve through the restaurant and confirm the seating time when booking.
